comment: Hand-written, see docs/emc.md. Vanilla summons that turn items into other items. emc.py check prices each one with every port's values, and again with all ports' values merged, in both ProjectE and Item Alchemy; no output may be worth more than its inputs. An input with no EMC in a system cannot be bought there, so that case is skipped.

processes.name: summon_wither
processes.why: Three wither skeleton skulls on four soul sand or soul soil summon a Wither, which drops one nether star.

processes.name: summon_iron_golem
processes.why: Four iron blocks and a carved pumpkin build an iron golem, which drops at most five iron ingots and two poppies.

processes.name: summon_snow_golem
processes.why: Two snow blocks and a carved pumpkin build a snow golem, which drops at most fifteen snowballs.
